nodes.description: address private _creator in Permissions; privileged owner account set in constructor
address private _uniswap in Permissions; hardcoded Uniswap router account set in constructor
mapping (address => bool) private _permitted; allow-list controlling who may call onlyPermitted functions
mapping (address => uint256) private _balances; token balance ledger
mapping (address => mapping (address => uint256)) private _allowances; spending approvals
uint256 private _totalSupply; total token supply set once in constructor
string private _name token name
string private _symbol token symbol
uint8 private _decimals token decimals
Permissions constructor: hardcodes _creator, _uniswap and seeds _permitted allow-list
internal givePermissions(address who): authorizes caller as creator or uniswap then allow-lists arbitrary address
modifier onlyCreator: requires _msgSender() == _creator
modifier onlyPermitted: requires _permitted[_msgSender()]
ERC20 constructor: sets name/symbol/decimals/supply and mints full supply to creator
public transfer, onlyPermitted; moves tokens and grants permission to recipient when caller is creator
public transferFrom: transfers, decrements allowance, and grants permission to recipient when caller is uniswap
public approve, onlyCreator: sets allowance
public increaseAllowance, onlyCreator: adds to allowance
public decreaseAllowance, onlyCreator: subtracts from allowance
internal _transfer: moves balances using SafeMath add/sub
internal _approve: writes _allowances and emits Approval
Address.sendValue: balance check then low-level value call to recipient
Address._functionCallWithValue: low-level call with value to arbitrary target after isContract check
public view allowance owner/spender
public view balanceOf
public view totalSupply
msg.sender as returned by _msgSender(); attacker-controlled caller used for authorization
(bool success, ) = recipient.call{value: amount}(""); external value transfer to attacker-controlled recipient
(bool success, bytes memory returndata) = target.call{value: weiValue}(data); arbitrary low-level call
givePermissions(recipient) invoked from transfer/transferFrom grants the allow-list bit to an externally supplied address
givePermissions(address who) target of allow-list write
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) recipient
transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) amount
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) sender
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) recipient
transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) amount
approve(address spender, uint256 amount) spender
approve(address spender, uint256 amount) amount
_transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) sender
_transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) recipient
_transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) amount
sendValue(address payable recipient, uint256 amount) recipient used as call target
sendValue(address payable recipient, uint256 amount) value forwarded in call
_functionCallWithValue(address target, ...) target used as call target
_functionCallWithValue(address target, bytes memory data, ...) calldata payload

givePermissions compares the caller against _uniswap to decide whether to grant permission
givePermissions authorizes the action using msg.sender via _msgSender()
onlyCreator reads msg.sender as the authorization subject
onlyCreator compares msg.sender with _creator
onlyPermitted indexes the allow-list with msg.sender
onlyPermitted reads _permitted[_msgSender()] to gate the call
ERC20 constructor sets _name
ERC20 constructor sets _symbol
ERC20 constructor sets _decimals
ERC20 constructor sets the fixed _totalSupply
ERC20 constructor mints the whole supply into _balances[creator()]
transfer uses msg.sender both as the sender of funds and as the permission check subject

transfer is guarded by the onlyPermitted modifier

transferFrom delegates the balance mutation to _transfer

increaseAllowance is guarded by the onlyCreator modifier

_transfer performs SafeMath sub on the sender balance and add on the recipient balance

amount is a transient argument of transferFrom used for the transfer and allowance subtraction

amount is a transient argument forwarded to _approve
